decisions.question: Which concrete U.S. church-linked sources have a verified written route across the target periods, and what is the next justified step?
decisions.count_definition: A written source qualifies here only when existing bounded project observations include at least one readable written homily/manuscript associated with a recorded 2022 date before November 30 and one with a recorded 2025 date, a named author, and an explicit institutional or author-affiliation link. This is a source-feasibility threshold, not independent delivery, copyright, corpus, full-year or causal validation.
limits: Six is a scoped positive source-evidence count, not a count of licensed, complete, representative or fully independent church panels.
The sources are purposefully discovered and geographically/traditionally unbalanced, not a national sample.
Author dates, publication dates, current affiliations, advertised events and actual delivered words remain separate evidence levels.
Do not add these counts to 86 supported identities, 150 historical entities, 12 earlier source screens or 47 item records.
No difference between 2022 and 2025 alone establishes AI adoption or causal AI effects.
A recorded date in the target period does not establish that the current surviving text version existed at that historical date.

items.name: Fourth Presbyterian Church
items.institution_link: Official church-hosted archive and manuscript bylines; dated bulletins document advertised services, not exact delivery.
items.annual_scope: Visible official year indexes enumerated: 55 records in 2022 and 52 in 2025, with 50/41 manuscript links. Selected 33 target checks produced 28 without an observed selected-field conflict. This is not a validated 107-text corpus.
items.next_step: Prioritize four separate speaker strata, same service type and season; use the new bulletin layer to avoid pooled-event comparisons. Do not silently reassign quarantined source mismatches.
items.rights: No explicit open sermon license established. Exact acquisition, analysis and redistribution scope needs review.

audit_sources.evidence_note: Annual figures are the observed index inventory; bulletin metadata is a separate published-service-plan provenance layer, not manuscript delivery authentication.

items.name: St. Mark's Episcopal Church / Adam Thomas author archive
items.institution_link: Official church pages link the author archive and identify Thomas as rector. Selected sermon pages do not independently establish each delivery venue or historical appointment.
items.annual_scope: Author index enumerated 43/45 records in 2022/2025, covering 41/42 Sundays. Eight of nine selected October targets currently readable. Same-feast labels do not always mean same Bible passages.
items.next_step: Prioritize same author, scripture, season and version. The identified Proper 25 C pair is a qualitative starting point, not evidence of AI exposure.
items.rights: Observed BY-NC-ND 3.0 notice plus separately copyrighted quoted material. Do not substitute 4.0 terms, assume noncommercial research automatically qualifies, or infer blanket adaptation permission.

items.name: Memorial Congregational Church / Allen Vander Meulen author archive
items.institution_link: The three inspected manuscripts name the church as their venue. The official current profile identifies an affiliated streaming worship producer and occasional preacher, not evidence of weekly pastoral incumbency or each historical event.
items.annual_scope: Three bounded manuscript observations: one 2022 and two 2025. Annual inventory and regular weekly continuity not established.
items.next_step: Retain as a clearly attributed occasional-preacher supplement, not the main continuous panel. Verify each work's license and version before proposed reuse.
items.rights: Individual inspected works show BY-NC 4.0 terms; this does not license unrelated works, third-party quotations, all project purposes or prove historical delivery.
